thread:
mia-ae: FYI MedSys sent back a redline asking for MFN + 24mo price protection. They want POC discount auto-applied to future pricing and unlimited retroactive credits if we ever price lower.

sam-legal: Oof. MFN + unlimited retro credits is a non-starter. We can offer narrow MFN for the same commercial offering & deployment model, limited lookback, and explicit exclusions.

dan-finance: Agree. Unlimited retro = write-off risk. Suggest cap = lesser of 6 months invoiced or 4% of the first-year contract value. If ARR > $1M, escalate to Rev Ops for scaled cap.

lee-ps: Technical note: their POC is on shared hosted infra with a "pilot" SKU that has aggressive discounts and different latency/kv cache behavior. We must exclude pilot/trial SKUs and any promotional model-release pricing.

carol-vp-sales: We need something we can sign this week. What's the fastest acceptable compromise to present to MedSys without involving exec escalation?

sam-legal: Draft compromise we can push now: MFN applies only to published list prices or executed, fully-executed customer agreements for equivalent offering and term. Price protection limited to 12 months after go-live. Retro credits capped at lesser of 6 months invoiced or $75k. Exclusions: trial/POC, partner/promotional discounts, non-equivalent deployment (hosted vs dedicated), and pre-release model offers. Audit right if MedSys claims a better price.

dan-finance: $75k cap fine for expected deal size, but make cap formula-based in doc: fallback to 3% of ARR if that is higher. Prevent hard-coded small caps for enterprise deals.

mia-ae: MedSys is pushing on 24 months and full retro. Exec sponsor is impatient. I'll present the 12m/6m + $75k / 3% of ARR formula and flag VP escalation if they push.

lee-ps: Operationally, mark all POC invoices as "POC - excluded from MFN" and add a single-line SOW clause so accounting and billing can filter. That prevents a downstream credit loop.

carol-vp-sales: Dealdesk-bot, can we auto-approve that cap for this opportunity? Need to know if we should route to Rev Ops.

dealdeck-bot: Approval flow: legal + finance sign-off required. If ARR > $1,000,000 or requested retro > $100k, escalate to Rev Ops. Current opp ARR flagged at ~$420k so standard approval applies.

sam-legal: I'll push a redline tonight with the language and the cap + formula. Include survival clause and narrow MFN definition. Also add "publicly available pricing or fully executed equivalent agreements" only.

dan-finance: Finance signs off conditionally on the formula and the POC exclusion mechanics. If MedSys negotiates steep committed pricing below our lowest committed tier, we need a pre-approved exception before granting.

mia-ae: Thanks. I'll send MedSys the counter with the POC carveout and the proposed cap. If they insist on 24mo / unlimited retro, escalate to Carol.

carol-vp-sales: Good plan. Keep me posted if they push beyond the formula. We need to close but not set a precedent.

lee-ps: One more flag: if they require data residency and push to private deployment, pricing/commits change materially. Notify product if that comes up.

mia-ae: Noted. I'll update the timeline and attach the secQ.

sam-legal: Draft posted to the thread. Action items: 1) Mia send to MedSys, 2) Finance confirm final cap formula in contract language, 3) PS ensure POC invoices are labelled.

dealdesk-bot: Thread closed pending counter-redline response.
